aceAnalysis.summary: Endpoint is publicly reachable and returns a branded Syra API Gateway page with coherent metadata matching the advertised Solana/x402 trading-agent positioning. However, no actual paid agent execution, API schema, machine-readable capability response, or MCP/A2A workflow was verified. The probe only confirmed a static HTML landing page and marketing content. Pricing signals are inconsistent: discovery metadata lists 0.000005 SOL while the page advertises 0.0001 USDC per signal. HEAD requests failed during preflight, and paid execution was skipped, so operational reliability and real tool capability remain unproven. Ace services used successfully: ace_serp_google_search, ace_openai_chat_completions, ace_localization_translate, ace_openai_images_edits.
